input: Explore local street food markets this month

gold.taskTitle: Explore Local Street Food Markets This Month
gold.taskDescription: Find and visit local street food markets within the month, making the most of the experience.

questions.title: Which city or neighborhood are you based in?
questions.description: Understanding the user's location to find relevant local markets.

questions.title: How many markets do you want to visit?
questions.description: Clarifying the scale of the goal — one market or several across the month.

questions.title: Do you have a specific weekend or date in mind?
questions.description: Identifying whether the user has timing preferences or constraints within the month.

questions.title: Are you going alone or with other people?
questions.description: Understanding the social context to tailor planning around group needs.

questions.title: Do you have any dietary restrictions or food preferences?
questions.description: Knowing food needs helps narrow down which markets or stalls are most suitable.

questions.title: Is this purely for eating or also for discovery and culture?
questions.description: Understanding the main motivation — tasting food, cultural immersion, photography, etc.

questions.title: What is your rough budget per market visit?
questions.description: Knowing the budget helps set realistic expectations for spending at each market.
